import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/training_9.csv"
]

# Target schema and dtypes
target_columns = ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
target_dtypes = {
    'admit': 'int64',
    'gre': 'int64',
    'gpa': 'float64',
    'prestige': 'int64'
}

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly the target columns
    # According to the prompt, all source schemas are identical to target schema
    # So no renaming or dropping needed
    
    # Enforce correct dtypes for safety
    df = df.astype(target_dtypes)
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (UNION operation)
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Final check: ensure columns and dtypes match target exactly
combined_df = combined_df[target_columns].astype(target_dtypes)

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/target_multisource_cot.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
